description: ÁREA DE RISCO DE INUNDAÇÃO BELO HORIZONTE is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Delimitação das áreas de risco de inundação no município de Belo Horizonte. Criada a partir da Carta de Inundação de 2009 do município de Belo Horizonte. Contém a identificação e a delimitação de áreas críticas ou potencialmente sujeitas à ocorrência de inundações, tendo sido atualizada parcialmente em 2013 e em 2024. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are area, risco, inundacao, hidrografia, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
